No characteristic-zero Fourier representation with multiplicities (2,1,1,2) in (++,-+,+-,--) order, with arbitrary legal bank parameters and phase weights.
independent_additions: Exact gcd(R,Rprime)=1; there are nine distinct edge singleton roots over the algebraic closure.
Original signed resolvent expansions checked polynomially for all four orientations.
Full remaining-row consistency-and-synthesis lemma, without an unsupported rank-six assumption.
Transpose symmetry excludes the mirrored partner (1,2,2,1); all 28 signed phase branches checked as literal polynomial matrices.
inherited_not_new: The prior accepted N7 row certificate already proves r_plus>=3 and r_minus>=3, hence total>=6.

Six-bank attainment in general and the exact N7 minimum.
excluded_claims: No claim of a six-bank original-resolvent witness.
No general lower bound of seven.

No extrapolation of ordinary finite-field search failure.
